text:
lina_sales: Heads up 10x Labs (pilot) triggered a big spike this week; invoice way over pilot cap. Customer asking for a waiver to avoid switching.

tom_revenue_ops: How much over and reason? billing error or deliberate tests?

lina_sales: ~$13,200 over. They ran automated QA suites on prod keys thinking pilot traffic was free. Logs show legitimate calls.

rachel_finance: Recommend a one-time concession. I can approve up to $7k. Anything above needs legal + head of finance sign-off.

kevin_legal: If >$5k, we need an exception memo and an amendment clarifying test environments. I can draft quickly.

lina_sales: Customer offers a 2-month prepaid commitment if we cover $10k. They’re high potential ARR.

rachel_finance: Given retention value, approve $10k conditional on signed 2-mo prepaid and an exception memo.

tom_revenue_ops: I'll add a billing flag to mute test traffic and create alert rules.

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-10XL-2026 for $10,000. Waiting on amendment upload.

kevin_legal: Draft uploaded to /contracts/drafts/10xlab_amend_2026.pdf and exception logged.

lina_sales: Signed commitment uploaded at 1795020000. Please apply credit.

billing-bot: Applied credit. Invoice updated, outstanding balance reduced. :white_check_mark:
